BUBT Book Shop

  • BUBT Bookshop is a dedicated service point for students, graduates, faculty members, and staff of Bangladesh University of Business and Technology (BUBT). The bookshop plays an important role in supporting academic and institutional needs by providing a wide range of educational materials and branded merchandise. Along with academic books and stationery, BUBT Bookshop offers various gift and branding items such as books, T-shirts, Parker pens, ties, branding bags for boys, bags for girls’ students, branding tissue boxes, and other assorted goods. These items help promote the identity, values, and pride of BUBT while meeting the practical needs of the university community.

    Vision:
    To become a trusted and well-recognized university bookshop that supports academic excellence and institutional branding by providing quality products and services to the BUBT community.

    Mission:
    To supply academic books, stationery, and essential materials that support learning and teaching at BUBT.
    To provide high-quality branded gift items for students, graduates, and university events.
    To promote BUBT’s identity and values through innovative and attractive branding products.
    To ensure affordability, quality, and customer satisfaction for all members of the university community.
    To continuously expand and improve product variety in response to the needs of students and graduates.

  • The BUBT Book Shop is conveniently located on the ground floor of the Martyr Tahmid Abdullah Building, making it easily accessible to all members of the university community.
